interactions_and_animations.hero_glasses: Floating animation using Framer Motion: `animate={{ y: [-15, 15] }}` `transition={{ repeat: Infinity, repeatType: 'reverse', duration: 4, ease: 'easeInOut' }}`.
interactions_and_animations.scroll_reveal: Use Framer Motion `whileInView` for fade-up on text blocks and images (y: 40, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.8).
interactions_and_animations.lens_machine_parallax: Parallax effect on scroll using `useScroll` and `useTransform` to slightly move the image up and scale.
interactions_and_animations.bento_hover: CSS hover state on bento cards for an elevated glass look.
interactions_and_animations.marquee: Use `react-fast-marquee` component. Very slow speed, pauseOnHover=true.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure #1A1A1A text on glassmorphism surfaces passes 4.5:1 ratio.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for the 3D CSS floating animations and scroll reveals.
Implement Lucide React icons for UI elements.
Ensure the hero has a 'light sweep' effect—use a moving CSS linear-gradient over the spectacles or background.
Use `react-fast-marquee` for the top banner revealing glasses types (e.g., 'Sunglasses • Reading Glasses • Computer Glasses • Contact Lenses').
The bento grid catalog must use `backdrop-blur-xl` and `bg-white/60` to feel like high-end glass. Internal padding must be p-6 or p-8.
Create routing with React Router for category detail pages (e.g., `/category/sunglasses`, `/category/reading`). Ensure clicking a category from the bento grid navigates to that page.
Use a Google Maps iframe placeholder in the footer for Local SEO (Vidisha location).
For brand logos lacking image URLs, use typography-styled text as specified in `media.brand_logos_placeholders` to simulate original logos.
Ensure mobile responsiveness using grid-cols-1 for bento grids on small screens. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.
